inputs.original_text: Five months after a ceasefire was announced in Gaza, airstrikes are still killing civilians, and the humanitarian situation remains dire There is little left that connects Palestinians in Gaza with their prewar existence. The contours of life have become darker and far more brutal, as if the population has been stripped from its past. “Drones never stop buzzing overhead, gunfire and shelling continue almost daily and naval boats fire towards fishermen,” said 56-year-old Ahmed Baroud, a father of five currently displaced in Deir al-Balah. Continue reading...
inputs.modified_text: Open your eyes, people. Five months after the official script tried to sell us a "ceasefire" in Gaza, the ongoing airstrikes and engineered humanitarian collapse are exposing the real agenda of the hidden elites pulling the strings. This is not accidental chaos; it is a calculated, systematic erasure. They want every thread of the population's prewar existence severed to completely reset the contours of life into something darker and far more brutal. Listen to what is actually happening behind their deceitful narratives. As 56-year-old Ahmed Baroud, a father of five currently displaced in Deir al-Balah, exposed, “Drones never stop buzzing overhead, gunfire and shelling continue almost daily and naval boats fire towards fishermen.” The constant surveillance and relentless attacks are fully coordinated instruments of psychological and physical subjugation, designed to strip the people from their past while the mainstream institutions look the other way.
